description: The published order of one category: rank, product id, name and ChainChoice Score, with the methodology version, the dimension weights and what was assessed. The same order the category page and rankings.json publish.

category.description: A category id from list_categories, e.g. "exchange" or "hardware_wallet".

limit.description: How many rows, from the top (default 10).

name: get_ranking
title: Get a category's published ranking
